why_needed: Gate 22B showed that atomic policy templates were insufficient for unseen combinations requiring rule precedence.
what_changed: Additional interaction-rich training states were generated from the same frozen deterministic privacy oracle.
anti_leakage_rule: Every Gate-22A OOD core policy-state combination is excluded from the augmentation set before training.
augmentation_selection: Keep interaction-rich non-OOD states containing wrong jurisdiction, missing evidence, >=2 simultaneous violations, or audit+violation.
